label: Master password
type: the secret that protects the encryption-at-rest key and other on-node secrets, supplied at node start-up. NOT a user credential and not an RBAC concept - it authenticates nothing and holds no role.
note: See encryption:encryption-at-rest-key. The 'must not be confused with' clause is load-bearing here: this round promoted a large identity/credential vocabulary (server:user, auth-mechanism:username-password) into the same registry, and 'master password' is the one password-shaped term in it that is not a login.
